import numpy as np, cv2
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open(\"first_frame.png\").convert(\"RGB\"))
gray = cv2.cvtColor(im, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
# card bright mask, exclude wall (wall ~110-145). card ~170-190
m = ((gray>158)&(np.indices(gray.shape)[0]>40)).astype(np.uint8)*255
m = cv2.morphologyEx(m, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
cnts,_ = cv2.findContours(m, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
cnts = sorted(cnts, key=cv2.contourArea, reverse=True)[:3]
for c in cnts:
    print(\"area\", cv2.contourArea(c))
    approx = cv2.approxPolyDP(c, 0.03*cv2.arcLength(c,True), True)
    print(\"approx\", approx.reshape(-1,2).tolist())
    x,y,w,h = cv2.boundingRect(c)
    print(\"bbox\", x,y,w,h)
# back panel: medium gray trapezoid around x 98-118
# platform dark mask in lower half
mp = ((gray<35)&(np.indices(gray.shape)[0]>95)).astype(np.uint8)*255
mp = cv2.morphologyEx(mp, cv2.MORPH_CLOSE, np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
cnts2,_ = cv2.findContours(mp, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
cnts2 = sorted(cnts2, key=cv2.contourArea, reverse=True)[:3]
for c in cnts2:
    print(\"plat area\", cv2.contourArea(c), \"bbox\", cv2.boundingRect(c))
EOF"
